findings.location: HTML, section “Todos os demais,” first paragraph
findings.source_quote: If someone has not had a COVID infection, I would certainly lean towards getting the vaccine.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “eu certamente tenderia a recomendar que tomasse a vacina” with “eu certamente tenderia a tomar a vacina” to preserve the author’s personal inclination rather than make it a recommendation to others.
findings.translation_quote: Se alguém não teve uma infecção por COVID, eu certamente tenderia a recomendar que tomasse a vacina.

findings.location: HTML, section “Todos os demais,” first paragraph
findings.source_quote: For those who are working in health care, I would lean towards getting one of the vaccines.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “eu tenderia a recomendar uma das vacinas” with “eu tenderia a tomar uma das vacinas” to retain the author’s stated personal inclination, not turn it into advice.
findings.translation_quote: Para aqueles que trabalham na área da saúde, eu tenderia a recomendar uma das vacinas.
